hero.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 Wiki
hero.description: Your complete guide to builds, boss strategies, weapons, and walkthrough for Expedition 33.

paragraphs: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is a turn-based RPG with real-time combat mechanics from Sandfall Interactive. Combine strategic party builds with skill-based dodging and parrying to overcome challenging bosses.
Six playable characters, each with unique mechanics: Gustave's Charge system, Lune's Elemental Stains, Maelle's Battle Stances, Sciel's Foretell, Verso's Perfection Ranks, and Monoco's Bestial Wheel.
